testsuite.name: run.trama.saga.workflow.SplitJoinWorkflowExecutorTest

testcase.name: split spawns one child per branch and parks the parent in WaitingJoin()
a join whose joinNodeId no longer resolves is finalized as CORRUPTED instead of retried forever()
split redelivery reconstructs deterministic children instead of a fresh random batch()
a failed branch is reflected in the join result without blocking the barrier()
a failure inside resumeAfterJoin restores the WaitingJoin pointer instead of losing it()
redelivering the split step itself does not re-enqueue already-registered branches()
redelivering a branch before its sibling arrives does not inflate the arrival count()
join only fires once the last branch arrives, then resumes the parent()
a failure during the commit phase does not resurrect the WaitingJoin pointer()
